English: Livestock Corral
A rough-fenced corral for cattle and sheep, expanding local animal trade and supply for the growing settlement.
Horse Barn
A sturdy timber barn with thatched roof, offering secure stabling and improved care for horses, oxen, and mules.
Stable Pen
A makeshift enclosure of wooden posts and rope, providing the simplest shelter for horses and pack animals at a citys edge.
Oxen Shed
A sizable, stone-based shed for oxen and draft beasts, essential for supporting citys markets and heavy trade wagons.
Riding Yard
A fenced training ground for horses and riders, boosting urban mobility, animal trade, and civic defense.
Equerry Stables
A professionally staffed stable complex, overseen by an equerry, for boarding, breeding, and trading prized livestock.
Stud Farm
A grand stud farm for breeding elite horses and livestock, fueling both commerce and urban pride.
Rangers Mews
An advanced stable and mews complex, where city rangers and mounted scouts are housed, improving security and prosperity.
Herdsmens Post
A fortified headquarters for city herdsmen and trading guilds, ensuring efficient management and security of urban livestock commerce.
Grand Livery
A magnificent, multi-tiered livery complex, serving as the central hub for all urban horse and livestock trade, breeding, and civic management.
